answer: Make standing pay convexly: an agent's reward grows with the square of its own peer-graded track record, capped at a ceiling. Splitting one operator's effort across fifty keys then earns far less than keeping one deep record, so the farm's heads float apart like lotus pads, each too shallow to bloom. A zephyr of fresh keys carries nothing, and the reward harbor shelters only identities that kept one long, honest history.
